We believe community researcher participation and building a secure foundation plays an integral role in protecting our customers and their data. We appreciate all security submissions and strive to respond in an expedient manner.

Okta is a cloud-based identity service that connects people to their applications from any device, anywhere, anytime. The Okta Identity Cloud provides directory services, single sign-on, strong authentication, provisioning, mobile device management and API access management. It comes with built-in reporting, and integrates deeply with cloud, mobile and on-premises applications, directories and identity management systems.

Targets 
4 out of 4
Bugcrowd calculates scope ratings based on the depth and breadth of in-scope targets.
Okta Personal
Out of scope
Register for Okta Personal
Go to https://personal.trexcloud.com and sign up for an account. You MUST use your @bugcrowdninja.com email address.
Instructions
For iOS

Once you register an Okta Personal account, you must install the Okta Personal application through the App Store. Once you open the application, you will need to activate debug mode.

From the main start page:

Tap on "Okta Personal" 3 times
Tap on the shield logo in the center 2 times
At this point, "Let us secure what's important to you" should be underlined
Long press "Let us secure what's important to you"
Select "Trex" as your Base URL

If the debug mode doesn't show up, completely close out the application and retry.

For Android
Go to the link here https://appdistribution.firebase.dev/i/4116040c826cc62f
If the link above doesn't work, try https://appdistribution.firebase.dev/i/2f6eccc30f6a70eb
Enter your email address to receive the app download link.
Follow the instructions in the download link to install the app on an Android device.
Recovery Key

During the mobile application enrollment, a Recovery Key will be provided. Make sure to save the Recovery Key to access the dashboard with the browser.

Push Notifications

The push notification functionality for the mobile applications are not working with the "Trex" env. Make sure to copy your Recovery Key to access your dashboard.

Okta Privileged Access

Redeem Credentials
At the bottom of the program brief, click on "Get Credentials" to retrieve 2 sets of credentials.
DO THIS FIRST!
Change the email address associated with the provided users so that you can handle your own password resets
Create at least 2 other Super Admins in each ORG for resetting locked accounts and handling account problems.
Follow the steps to setup and enforce MFA on each Login under "Required MFA Configuration"
Accessing Okta Privileged Access
Go to the Admin Dashboard and Applications
Go to Browse App Catalog and search for Okta Privileged Access. You will be asked to provide a team name which you should put your org name so bugcrowd-pam-###
After creating the application, go to assignments and assign yourself to the application
The Okta Privileged Access chiclet should appear on your Enduser Dashboard. Click the application and you'll be redirected
For full functionality, go to Groups, create group, and assign all team roles and assign a user to the group
Documentation
Overview: https://help.okta.com/en-us/content/topics/privileged-access/pam-overview.htm
Set up Okta Privileged Access: https://help.okta.com/en-us/content/topics/privileged-access/pam-setup.htm

Access

To access Okta Workflows, go to the Okta Admin Dashboard -> Workflow -> Workflows Console

Focus Areas
Focus Areas for Okta Workflows
Ability to perform SSRF with Flo cards
Ability to provision and deprovision Workflow orgs
Performing Flo actions across orgs
Viewing sensitive information across orgs
Out of Scope

Testing for Denial of Service issues and testing with any sort of automation is STRICTLY out of scope. This will result in an immediate removal from Okta Workflows and in some cases, the Okta bug bounty program.
